posts.title: How can an app be free?
posts.description: Modern web apps with minimal traffic really don’t require much infrastructure. As Kohlrabi scales, its costs will go up, but I expect to be able to cover all of this through donations. Fundamentally, it does not make sense to charge for an app that brings me fulfillment to create. I made this for me, and I think others may enjoy it too.
